items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep searchwoot.com private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Evidence shows Woot API access and rate limits, but no permission to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data; public terms point against the proposed commercial/public use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and launch-owner gates are also incomplete. Human counsel is required before rights outreach, public exposure, affiliate use, advertising, or any exception.

Fleet compliance baseline is technical triage only: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 checked properties. Twenty findings each remain for banner, consent accept, consent reject, and GA4 checks; four privacy and four terms findings remain. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a standalone growth blocker, but do not clear affected launch or monetization gates without site-specific evidence.

For parked or gated properties, retain the concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or new queue entry is cleared.
